title: Lease Term Agreement Renewal Terms — Early Renewal, Balance Standing and Rescission
content:
These terms set, per Lease Term Agreement program, the early renewal window and early renewal discount of the program, whether renewal offers are issued and accepted only while the lease has no past-due balance, and the calendar days after signing within which a signed renewal may be rescinded without charge.

| Term program | Early renewal window (calendar days before the term end date) | Early renewal discount (dollars a month) | Renewal only with no past-due balance | Rescission period after signing (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 0 (no early renewal discount) | 0.00 | Yes | 0 (no rescission) |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 0 (no early renewal discount) | 0.00 | Yes | 3 |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 30 | 15.00 | Yes | 3 |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 45 | 25.00 | Yes | 3 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 45 | 30.00 | Yes | 5 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 45 | 35.00 | Yes | 5 |

## Terms explained

- **Early renewal window.** A renewal signed at least this many calendar days before the term end date earns the program's early renewal discount; a window of 0 means the program carries no early renewal discount.
- **Early renewal discount.** The monthly reduction of the offered rent that the program's early renewal earns.
- **No past-due balance.** For every program the value is Yes: renewal offers are issued and accepted only while the lease has no past-due balance.
- **Rescission period.** The calendar days after signing a renewal during which the resident may rescind it without charge; a program with 0 days has no rescission.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Standard Lease (10-12 Months) program shows a window of 45 days and a discount of 25.00 dollars a month; a Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) program shows 30 days and 15.00 dollars. A Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) program shows no early renewal discount but a rescission period of 3 days.
